before: Posted comment bodies could not change. Correcting text required a reply or thread deletion.
after: Comment and reply bodies support atomic plain-text replacement. The write preserves comment attributes, terminal paragraph identifiers, thread state, and document anchors. Concurrent replacements retain one complete draft. Multi-comment batches share one journal and one undo step.
reason: The writer reuses existing paragraph replacement and split-lineage fields. Released materializers already select one surviving lineage. No field, encoding, reader, or repair rule changes. Real editor sessions cover concurrency, history, reconnect, deletion, thread metadata, and save/reopen. The mixed-version scenario verifies released readers and released reply and resolution writes against candidate replacements.
